name: Hummus with Pita
reasons: Technique fried -> raw; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Drain canned chickpeas and reserve the liquid (aquafaba).
Blend chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and salt until very smooth.
Add a few tablespoons of aquafaba or ice water and blend again — this makes it extra fluffy.
Taste and adjust: more lemon, salt, or tahini to your preference.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and dust with paprika or cumin. Serve with warm pita.

name: Kebab
reasons: Technique pan_fry -> grilled; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
Include the mandatory 30 min refrigeration before shaping and grilling.

steps.display_text: Combine lamb mince with very finely grated onion, parsley, cumin, paprika, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Knead the mixture firmly for 3–5 minutes until it becomes cohesive and slightly sticky.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Shape onto flat metal skewers with wet hands.
Grill over charcoal or a very hot grill pan, turning every 2 minutes for 8–10 minutes total.
Serve with flatbread, sliced onion sprinkled with sumac, and tomato.

name: Khachapuri (Adjarian Cheese Bread)
reasons: Include the mandatory 60 min dough rise; yeast activation and kneading remain in the active preparation allowance.

steps.display_text: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in warm milk and let it stand for 10 minutes until foamy.
Mix the flour and salt, then work in the yeast mixture to form a soft dough. Knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour until doubled.
Divide the dough in two and roll each piece into an oval. Fold the long edges inward and twist the ends to form a boat shape.
Fill each boat generously with cheese and place on a baking tray.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 12-15 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling.
Remove from the oven, crack an egg into the center of each boat, and return to the oven for 2 minutes until the egg is just set.
Top with a pat of butter and serve immediately, mixing the egg and cheese together before tearing off bread to dip.

components.extra_comment: or a mix of mozzarella and feta

name: Knödel with Gravy
reasons: Technique baked -> simmered; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
Withdraw the unverified vegetarian claim: dashi / roast gravy is unspecified. Restore only after confirming a vegetarian variant; ingredients are not silently substituted.

steps.display_text: Slice stale bread into cubes. Pour warm milk over and let soak for 15–20 minutes.
Sauté diced onion in butter until golden. Add to bread with eggs, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Mix thoroughly. If too wet, add a spoonful of flour.
With wet hands, form into firm round dumplings.
Simmer gently (not boiling) in salted water for 20 minutes. Turn once halfway.
Serve with roast gravy and braised red cabbage.

name: Lahmacun
reasons: Include the mandatory 30 min dough rest.
Remove the under-30 tag because corrected elapsed time exceeds 30 minutes.

steps.display_text: Make a simple yeasted dough. Rest 30 minutes and roll paper thin.
Process lamb mince with grated tomato, onion, parsley, cumin, paprika, salt, and chili into a paste.
Spread a very thin layer of meat paste on each flatbread, right to the edges.
Bake in the hottest oven possible (250°C+) for 6–8 minutes until edges crisp and meat is cooked.
Roll up with sliced tomato, parsley, and a squeeze of lemon. Eat with your hands.

name: Lamb Kleftiko
reasons: Technique pan_fry -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
The recipe requires 180 min baking and at least 120 min marinade, plus 20 min preparation.

steps.display_text: Score lamb deeply and push garlic cloves and oregano into the cuts.
Marinate in lemon juice, olive oil, and oregano for 2–4 hours.
Place lamb on a large piece of baking parchment with sliced potato, tomato, and chunks of feta.
Fold parchment tightly to seal, creating a parcel. Secure with string.
Bake at 160°C for 3 hours. The lamb should be completely tender and falling off the bone.
Open parcel at the table to release the aromatic steam. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Lasagna
reasons: Technique boiled -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
Allow 30 min sauce simmer + 50 min baking + 10 min browning, then the mandatory 10 min rest.

steps.display_text: Make the meat sauce: brown the beef mince with chopped onion and carrot. Add the tomatoes and simmer for about 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and have the prepared béchamel ready.
Spread a thin layer of meat sauce on the bottom of the baking dish.
Layer lasagna sheets, meat sauce, and béchamel. Repeat until the ingredients are used.
Finish with béchamel and grated parmesan.
Bake covered with foil for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 20 minutes until golden. Rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

name: Mamaliga with Bryndza
reasons: Technique baked -> simmered; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Bring salted water to a boil. Slowly pour cornmeal in a steady stream, whisking constantly.
Switch to a wooden spoon. Cook on medium heat for 20–25 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and pulling away from sides.
Remove from heat and stir in butter.
Pour onto a wooden board or plates. Make a well in the centre.
Fill the well with crumbled bryndza cheese. Serve immediately with cold sour cream.

name: Manti (Turkish Dumplings)
reasons: Technique baked -> boiled; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Make stiff egg dough. Knead well and rest 30 minutes.
Mix beef mince with grated onion, salt, and pepper.
Roll dough very thin. Cut into tiny 3x3 cm squares.
Place a tiny piece of filling (the size of a hazelnut) on each square. Pinch all four corners to the centre to seal.
Boil in salted water for 8–10 minutes until dough is tender.
Serve with garlic yogurt, and a drizzle of butter melted with paprika and dried mint.

name: Mashed Potatoes
reasons: Technique baked -> boiled; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Peel and cube potatoes. Cover with cold salted water and bring to a boil.
Cook for 15–20 minutes until completely tender when pierced. Drain thoroughly.
Return to the dry pot over low heat for 1 minute to drive off excess moisture.
Mash with a potato ricer or masher. Do not use a blender — it makes them gluey.
Gradually beat in hot milk and cold butter in stages until silky. Season with salt and a pinch of nutmeg.
